source_snapshot.procedure: Labels a Fatal injection and gives split railtype6/voltagetype0/dimm0 lines for all DIMMs and both voltage types, without pre-state, transition timing or reset behavior.
source_snapshot.criteria: Calls the result correctable and requires tool PASS plus OS reporting.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; a log keyword cannot prove input selection, transfer direction, droop or continuity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires supervision but does not resolve severity, triggers, transfer budget, latch/failback or memory integrity.

old_problem: Fatal and correctable semantics conflict; railtype6 trigger/direction, physical dual-input topology, initial selection, complete tuple expansion, transfer/droop limits, reset policy, latch and failback are undefined.
disposition_reason: A switchover is proven by synchronized electrical and input-select evidence, not generic logs. ED-03/12/15/16/18 prohibit guessing the OEM trigger, continuity threshold or recovery, so execution remains Pending/BLOCKED until a signed transition and failback contract exists.
decision_basis: Read exact row95/history2493 and kept this directional transfer distinct from row94 input-only and row96 thermal-warning coverage.
Preserved railtype6, both voltage types, every DIMM, fatal label, correctable criterion and PMIC/I2C settings.
Required VIN_Mgmt-active pre-state, healthy VIN_Bulk, synchronized selection/rail telemetry and explicit service/memory continuity limits.
Treated failback as a separately controlled recovery action, never an automatic retry.
No command join, transition, reset, failback or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: For each authorized PMIC/comparator, prove a directional management-to-bulk input transfer with bounded downstream interruption and no unapproved reset or memory corruption, then return to the preferred input through an approved failback.
required_package: Vendor railtype6, comparator/trigger, severity and reset definitions
Dual-input source-to-PMIC/DIMM/address and BMC I2C/OOB topology
Signed VIN_Mgmt initial-state and VIN_Bulk readiness criteria
Transfer time, droop/interruption, downstream rail, service and memory limits
Complete tuple command, latch/failback procedure, event oracle and restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the split source lines. After approval, establish VIN_Mgmt selected and VIN_Bulk valid, baseline selection/both inputs/downstream rails/memory, inject one exact railtype6 trigger once, measure the transfer and approved reset behavior, preserve fresh evidence, then perform separately authorized failback and complete restoration.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped PMIC transfers from VIN_Mgmt to healthy VIN_Bulk within signed time/droop limits, downstream power and memory/service stay within policy, fresh source-specific evidence appears, and authorized failback restores the preferred input and baseline state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires observed initial and final selection, correct direction, synchronized electrical continuity, approved severity/reset outcome, clean memory/service and proven failback. Event text alone, excess droop, wrong direction, reset contrary to policy, DIMM/MCA error or latched wrong input is FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Instrumented isolated SUT with independent OOB and synchronized dual-input/downstream capture.
Prove bulk source health before one authorized PMIC/comparator run.
Abort on wrong direction, threshold breach, excess interruption, unexpected reset, I2C loss or memory error.
No automatic failback, retry or next target.
expected_evidence: Pre-state proving VIN_Mgmt active and VIN_Bulk healthy
Exact tuple plus synchronized selection/input/output and OOB timeline
Fresh switchover PMIC/CPER/SEL source evidence and measured continuity
Memory/MCA/service results, latch state, authorized failback and restoration diff
test_case.recovery: Preserve the post-transfer state and evidence, then use only the approved failback to restore the preferred input. Restore PMIC recovery, SPD/telemetry, I2C and BIOS/HDT settings; verify stable rails, all DIMMs and bounded memory. Escalate any failed/latching transfer without retry.

source_conflict.reason: Fatal/correctable conflict, one split tuple for all targets and absent direction/timing/reset/failback criteria remain unresolved.

blocked.reason: An unauthoritative transfer can interrupt DDR5 power, reset the host, corrupt memory or leave the PMIC latched to the wrong input.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Railtype6 trigger/severity, dual-input target topology, pre-state, timing/droop/continuity limits, reset policy, latch/failback and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; BLOCKED; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
